blocks.zh: Section 0: Test Methods & Acceptance Criteria | 試驗方法與接受標準
blocks.en: Section 0: Test Methods & Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 說明 USP 〈789〉 的適用範圍及其與 〈788〉（一般注射劑）、〈771〉（眼用製劑品質測試）的關係
blocks.en: Explain the scope of USP <789> and its relationship to <788> (Injections) and <771> (Ophthalmic Products - Quality Tests)

blocks.zh: 理解眼用（眼內）溶液微粒的定義，以及為何需要獨立的微粒控制要求
blocks.en: Understand the definition of particulate matter in ophthalmic (intraocular) solutions and why separate particulate control requirements are needed

blocks.zh: 描述光遮蔽法 (Light Obscuration) 和顯微鏡法 (Microscopic Particle Count Test) 在眼用溶液中的應用條件與選擇原則
blocks.en: Describe the conditions of use and selection principles for Light Obscuration and the Microscopic Particle Count Test in ophthalmic solutions

blocks.zh: 精確記憶 〈789〉 的三個粒徑接受標準（≥10 µm、≥25 µm、≥50 µm）及對應限度
blocks.en: Memorize the three particle size acceptance criteria in <789> (≥10 µm, ≥25 µm, ≥50 µm) and their corresponding limits

blocks.zh: 連結 〈789〉 規格要求對眼科 CDMO 產品開發與批次放行的實際影響
blocks.en: Link the <789> specification requirements to their practical impact on product development and batch release at an ophthalmic CDMO

blocks.zh: Introduction & Scope — 簡介與適用範圍
blocks.en: Introduction & Scope

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 〈789〉 的演進：眼用 → 眼內
blocks.en: Core Concept - The Evolution of <789>: Ophthalmic to Intraocular

blocks.zh: USP 〈789〉 的歷史名稱是「Particulate Matter in Ophthalmic Solutions（眼用溶液微粒）」，但在 2024 年 5 月更新後，已更名為「Subvisible Particulate Matter in Intraocular Solutions（眼內溶液次可見微粒）」。
blocks.en: USP <789> was historically titled "Particulate Matter in Ophthalmic Solutions", but after the May 2024 update it was renamed "Subvisible Particulate Matter in Intraocular Solutions".

blocks.zh: 這個改名有重要意義：
blocks.en: This renaming is significant:

blocks.zh: 眼用 (ophthalmic)：廣義，包含滴眼液、眼膏、隱形眼鏡護理液等各種眼部用藥
blocks.en: Ophthalmic: a broad term covering eye drops, ointments, contact lens care solutions and other products used on the eye

blocks.zh: 眼內 (intraocular)：特指直接注射進入眼球內部的製劑，如抗 VEGF 藥物（治療黃斑部病變）、眼內手術沖洗液等
blocks.en: Intraocular: specifically products injected directly into the eyeball, such as anti-VEGF drugs (for macular degeneration) and intraocular surgical irrigating solutions

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 的更新反映了眼內注射劑市場的快速成長（抗 VEGF 生物製劑是全球最大市場之一），以及這類產品對微粒控制更嚴格的需求。
blocks.en: The update to <789> reflects the rapid growth of the intraocular injectable market (anti-VEGF biologics are among the largest markets worldwide) and the stricter particulate control these products demand.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 為什麼眼內製劑比一般注射劑更嚴格？
blocks.en: Analogy - Why Are Intraocular Products Held to a Stricter Standard Than Ordinary Injections?

blocks.zh: 想像你要在一個密閉的玻璃球（眼球）裡注射藥物。這個玻璃球沒有免疫系統保護，沒有血流稀釋，沒有巨噬細胞清除異物 — 任何微粒都會直接留在眼球內部。
blocks.en: Imagine injecting a drug into a sealed glass sphere (the eyeball). This sphere has no immune protection, no bloodstream to dilute the drug and no macrophages to clear foreign matter, so any particle stays inside the eye.

blocks.zh: 眼球的特殊脆弱性：
blocks.en: The special vulnerability of the eye:

blocks.zh: 無法「排出」異物：靜脈注射中的微粒最終會被肝臟或脾臟的巨噬細胞清除；但眼內的微粒可能永久存在
blocks.en: No way to "clear" foreign matter: particles from an intravenous injection are eventually cleared by macrophages in the liver or spleen, but particles inside the eye may persist permanently

blocks.zh: 光學精確性要求：眼球是精密光學器官，即使是透明的微粒都可能影響視力
blocks.en: Optical precision requirements: the eye is a precision optical organ, and even transparent particles can affect vision

blocks.zh: 炎症敏感性：眼內炎 (endophthalmitis) 即使輕微也可能導致永久失明
blocks.en: Sensitivity to inflammation: endophthalmitis, even if mild, can lead to permanent blindness

blocks.zh: 因此 〈789〉 比 〈788〉 多了一個 ≥50 µm 的粒徑限度，對大顆粒更加嚴格。
blocks.en: For this reason, <789> adds a ≥50 µm size limit that <788> does not have, imposing stricter control on large particles.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 〈789〉 與 〈771〉 的層次關係
blocks.en: Key Point - The Hierarchy Between <789> and <771>

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑的微粒測試受到多個 USP 章節的規管，層次關係如下：
blocks.en: Particulate testing of ophthalmic products is governed by several USP chapters, in the following hierarchy:

blocks.zh: 〈771〉 Ophthalmic Products — Quality Tests：眼用製劑的總綱性品質測試章節，規定眼用製劑必須達到「基本上無可見微粒」
blocks.en: <771> Ophthalmic Products - Quality Tests: the general quality-test chapter for ophthalmic products, requiring that they be "essentially free from visible particulates"

blocks.zh: 〈790〉 Visible Particulates in Injections：可見微粒的目視檢查方法
blocks.en: <790> Visible Particulates in Injections: the visual inspection method for visible particulates

blocks.zh: 〈789〉：專門針對眼內溶液的次可見微粒計數測試，是 〈788〉 的眼科專用版本
blocks.en: <789>: the subvisible particle count test specifically for intraocular solutions, an ophthalmic-specific version of <788>

blocks.zh: 個別品種專論 (individual monograph) 的規定優先於通則章節，如有疑義，以專論為準。
blocks.en: The requirements of an individual monograph take precedence over general chapters; in case of doubt, the monograph prevails.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個眼科 CDMO 接到一個高黏度玻璃體腔注射劑（intravitreal injection）的委託。LO 法無法直接測試，必須稀釋。稀釋驗證的關鍵考量是什麼？
blocks.en: An ophthalmic CDMO receives a contract for a high-viscosity intravitreal injection. The LO method cannot test it directly, so dilution is required. What are the key considerations for validating the dilution?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 〈789〉 指出「許多利益相關方選擇 LO 法作為首選，尤其是當矽油可能存在時」？矽油在眼科製劑中的角色是什麼，它如何影響測試方法選擇？
blocks.en: Why does <789> state that "many stakeholders choose the LO method as the first choice, especially when silicone oil may be present"? What role does silicone oil play in ophthalmic products, and how does it affect the choice of test method?

blocks.zh: Light Obscuration Particle Count Test — 光遮蔽微粒計數法
blocks.en: Light Obscuration Particle Count Test

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 典型眼內注射劑的粒子容許量
blocks.en: Formulas and Calculations - Allowable Particle Counts for a Typical Intraocular Injection

blocks.zh:
典型玻璃體腔注射劑 (intravitreal injection) 體積：0.05–0.1 mL

以 0.05 mL 計算（最小常見劑量）：
─────────────────────────────────────
≥10 µm：0.05 × 50 = 2.5 粒/劑量 → 平均不得超過 2.5 粒
≥25 µm：0.05 × 5  = 0.25 粒/劑量 → 平均不得超過 0.25 粒
≥50 µm：0.05 × 2  = 0.1 粒/劑量  → 極嚴格！

與 〈788〉 SVP（以 5 mL 小瓶計）比較：
  〈788〉 ≥10 µm：6,000 粒/容器 = 1,200/mL
  〈789〉 ≥10 µm：50/mL

結論：〈789〉 限度是 〈788〉 的 1/24 — 眼內製劑要求
嚴格程度是一般注射劑的 24 倍以上。
blocks.en:
Typical intravitreal injection volume: 0.05–0.1 mL

Calculated for 0.05 mL (the smallest common dose):
─────────────────────────────────────
≥10 µm: 0.05 × 50 = 2.5 particles/dose → average must not exceed 2.5 particles
≥25 µm: 0.05 × 5  = 0.25 particles/dose → average must not exceed 0.25 particles
≥50 µm: 0.05 × 2  = 0.1 particles/dose  → extremely strict!

Comparison with <788> SVP (based on a 5 mL vial):
  <788> ≥10 µm: 6,000 particles/container = 1,200/mL
  <789> ≥10 µm: 50/mL

Conclusion: the <789> limit is 1/24 of the <788> limit - intraocular products are held to
a standard more than 24 times stricter than ordinary injections.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — ≥50 µm 限度的臨床意義
blocks.en: Key Point - Clinical Significance of the ≥50 µm Limit

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 比 〈788〉 多出一個 ≥50 µm 的粒徑類別（限度 2/mL），這在所有 USP 微粒章節中是唯一的。
blocks.en: <789> has one more size category than <788>, ≥50 µm (limit 2/mL), which is unique among all the USP particulate chapters.

blocks.zh: 臨床背景：
blocks.en: Clinical background:

blocks.zh: 眼科研究顯示，直徑 >25 µm 的微粒在玻璃體腔中更難以自然清除
blocks.en: Ophthalmic research shows that particles with a diameter >25 µm are harder to clear naturally from the vitreous cavity

blocks.zh: ≥50 µm 的大顆粒可能直接遮蔽視野，即使是短暫的也會引發患者不適
blocks.en: Large particles ≥50 µm can directly obstruct the visual field, causing patient discomfort even if only transient

blocks.zh: 此類大顆粒的存在往往指向製程中的顆粒污染問題（如矽化不均的注射器、配製過程中的聚集），是製程品質的指示器
blocks.en: The presence of such large particles often points to a particle contamination problem in the process (such as unevenly siliconized syringes or aggregation during compounding) and is an indicator of process quality

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — LO vs. 顯微鏡法：何時選哪個？
blocks.en: Analogy - LO vs. Microscopy: When to Choose Which?

blocks.zh: 把 LO 法想像成「全自動交通計數器」，顯微鏡法想像成「人工計程車司機辨識」：
blocks.en: Think of the LO method as a "fully automatic traffic counter" and microscopy as a "taxi driver identifying vehicles by eye":

blocks.zh: LO 法首選：速度快、自動化、結果客觀、特別適合含矽油的產品（矽油微滴通過 LO 也會被計數，反而是需要監控的對象）
blocks.en: LO as the first choice: fast, automated, objective results, and particularly suitable for products containing silicone oil (silicone oil microdroplets are also counted by LO, and they are in fact something that needs to be monitored)

blocks.zh: 顯微鏡法補充：當產品本身有顏色（會吸收光線、干擾 LO）、非常高黏度（無法流過 LO 感測器）、或需要形態學鑑定（是什麼種類的微粒？）時使用
blocks.en: Microscopy as a complement: used when the product itself is colored (absorbs light and interferes with LO), very highly viscous (cannot flow through the LO sensor), or when morphological identification is needed (what type of particle is it?)

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 明確說明：兩種方法的限度相同，選擇哪種方法取決於產品特性，需要在方法驗證階段確定。
blocks.en: <789> states explicitly that the limits are the same for both methods; which method to use depends on product characteristics and must be determined during method validation.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 〈789〉 vs. 〈788〉 限度比較
blocks.en: Core Concept - Comparing the <789> and <788> Limits

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 的限度與 〈788〉 的 SVP 限度有根本性差異：
blocks.en: The <789> limits differ fundamentally from the <788> SVP limits:

blocks.zh: 以一個典型眼內注射劑（0.1 mL）計算：
blocks.en: Calculated for a typical intraocular injection (0.1 mL):
≥10 µm: at most 5 particles (0.1 mL × 50/mL)

blocks.zh: ≥25 µm：最多 0.5 粒（平均值，實際上每批平均不得超過）
blocks.en: ≥25 µm: at most 0.5 particles (an average value; in practice the batch average must not exceed this)

blocks.zh: ≥50 µm：最多 0.2 粒（意味著非常嚴格的控制）
blocks.en: ≥50 µm: at most 0.2 particles (meaning very strict control)

blocks.zh: Microscopic Particle Count Test — 顯微鏡微粒計數法
blocks.en: Microscopic Particle Count Test

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 薄膜顯微鏡法的工作原理
blocks.en: Core Concept - How Membrane Microscopy Works

blocks.zh: Microscopic Particle Count Test (顯微鏡微粒計數法)：將已知體積的樣品通過孔徑約 1 µm 的薄膜（通常為聚碳酸酯膜），微粒被截留在薄膜表面，再用顯微鏡（通常 100× 放大）在透射光和反射光下計數並測量每個微粒的最大尺寸。
blocks.en: Microscopic Particle Count Test: a known volume of sample is passed through a membrane with a pore size of about 1 µm (usually polycarbonate), the particles are retained on the membrane surface, and they are then counted and measured for their maximum dimension under a microscope (usually at 100× magnification) using both transmitted and reflected light.

blocks.zh: 關鍵技術點：
blocks.en: Key technical points:

blocks.zh: 不計算模糊物質：凝膠狀、膜狀、或外觀像染色斑的物質不納入計數 — 這是一個重要的判斷要求，需要有經驗的分析員
blocks.en: Do not count indistinct material: gel-like or film-like material, or material that looks like a stain, is not included in the count - this is an important judgment requirement that calls for an experienced analyst

blocks.zh: 薄膜選擇：需根據黏度和化學相容性選擇適合的薄膜材質
blocks.en: Membrane selection: a suitable membrane material must be chosen based on viscosity and chemical compatibility

blocks.zh: 人工讀數的主觀性：相比 LO 法，顯微鏡法更依賴操作員的判斷，實驗室間再現性相對較低
blocks.en: Subjectivity of manual reading: compared with the LO method, microscopy relies more on operator judgment, and inter-laboratory reproducibility is relatively lower

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 兩種方法的限度完全相同
blocks.en: Key Point - The Limits Are Identical for the Two Methods

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 的一個重要特點：LO 法（Table 1）和顯微鏡法（Table 2）的接受標準完全相同（50/5/2 mL）。
blocks.en: An important feature of <789>: the acceptance criteria for the LO method (Table 1) and the microscopic method (Table 2) are identical (50/5/2 per mL).

blocks.zh: 這與 〈787〉 不同 — 在 〈787〉 中，顯微鏡法使用的是 〈788〉 的薄膜顯微鏡限度，且兩個方法的結果被明確宣告不等價。
blocks.en: This differs from <787> - in <787>, the microscopic method uses the membrane microscopic limits of <788>, and the results of the two methods are explicitly declared not equivalent.

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 設定統一限度的合理性：眼內製劑通常不含複雜的蛋白質聚集體，微粒主要是外源性或內源性的固態物質，兩種方法對此類微粒的計數結果較為接近，因此可以設定統一限度。
blocks.en: The rationale for a single set of limits in <789>: intraocular products generally do not contain complex protein aggregates; the particles are mainly extrinsic or intrinsic solid matter, and the two methods give fairly similar counts for such particles, so a single set of limits can be set.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 眼科 CDMO 的方法選擇決策
blocks.en: Practical Application - Test Method Selection Decisions at an Ophthalmic CDMO

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 承接了以下三種眼內產品，如何選擇測試方法：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO takes on the following three intraocular products; how would you choose the test method?

blocks.zh: 抗 VEGF mAb 眼內注射液（透明，低黏度，0.05 mL 劑量）： 優先選擇 LO 法 — 體積小（需要合併多支），使用 LO 的微量體積感測器頭
blocks.en: Anti-VEGF mAb intraocular injection (clear, low viscosity, 0.05 mL dose): LO is preferred - the volume is small (several units must be pooled), and an LO sensor head for small volumes is used

blocks.zh: 含矽油的玻璃體置換液（高黏度）： 考慮稀釋後 LO，或顯微鏡法 — 矽油本身的小液滴會干擾 LO 計數，需要方法驗證確認
blocks.en: Silicone oil-containing vitreous replacement fluid (high viscosity): consider LO after dilution, or microscopy - the small droplets of the silicone oil itself interfere with LO counting, so method validation is needed to confirm

blocks.zh: 有色澤的眼科沖洗液（略帶黃色）： 優先考慮顯微鏡法 — 顏色會干擾 LO 光路，導致假性高計數
blocks.en: Colored ophthalmic irrigating solution (slightly yellow): microscopy is preferred - the color interferes with the LO light path and causes falsely high counts

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 「不計算凝膠狀物質」的判斷難度
blocks.en: Analogy - How Hard Is the "Do Not Count Gel-Like Material" Judgment?

blocks.zh: 想像你在顯微鏡下看一塊濾膜，上面有：實心的沙粒（要計數），以及一些像果凍或水漬的東西（不計數）。
blocks.en: Imagine looking at a filter membrane under a microscope. On it you see solid grains of sand (to be counted) and some things that look like jelly or water stains (not to be counted).

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 要求分析員區分：
blocks.en: <789> requires the analyst to distinguish:

blocks.zh: 要計數：具有明確邊界、表面有立體感、能投射陰影的固態微粒
blocks.en: Count: solid particles with a clear boundary, a three-dimensional appearance on the surface and the ability to cast a shadow

blocks.zh: 不計數：無定形的、半液態的、看起來像染色或油膜的物質（這些可能是非固態的物質，如脂質、某些賦形劑的沉澱）
blocks.en: Do not count: amorphous, semi-liquid material that looks like a stain or oil film (these may be non-solid substances, such as lipids or precipitates of certain excipients)

blocks.zh: 這個判斷高度依賴操作員訓練和實驗室 SOP 的清晰描述，是顯微鏡法的主要主觀性來源。
blocks.en: This judgment depends heavily on operator training and on how clearly the laboratory SOP describes it, and it is the main source of subjectivity in the microscopic method.

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 規定兩種方法的限度相同，但 〈787〉 說兩種方法的結果不等價。如果你的 CDMO 同時承接眼內注射製劑（〈789〉）和蛋白質注射劑（〈787〉），在建立 QC 方法時，如何向客戶解釋這兩個章節對方法互換性的不同處理原則？
blocks.en: <789> specifies the same limits for both methods, but <787> says the results of the two methods are not equivalent. If your CDMO handles both intraocular injections (<789>) and protein injections (<787>), how would you explain to a client the different principles these two chapters apply to method interchangeability when establishing QC methods?

blocks.zh: 一個眼科製劑在顯微鏡下，操作員發現濾膜上有大量疑似「矽油液滴」的半透明球形物質。根據 〈789〉 的要求，這些物質應該計數還是不計數？如何判定？
blocks.en: Under the microscope, an operator finds a large number of translucent spherical objects on the membrane that look like "silicone oil droplets" in an ophthalmic product. According to <789>, should these be counted or not? How is this decided?

blocks.zh: 批次放行測試中，某批眼內注射液 LO 法 ≥50 µm 計數結果為 3/mL（超出限度 2/mL）。應採取哪些後續步驟？
blocks.en: In batch release testing, the LO result for ≥50 µm in a batch of intraocular injection is 3/mL (exceeding the limit of 2/mL). What follow-up steps should be taken?

blocks.zh: Chapter Comparison — 〈787〉、〈788〉、〈789〉 對照總覽
blocks.en: Chapter Comparison - Overview of <787>, <788> and <789>

blocks.zh: 原文內容 — Regulatory Context
blocks.en: Original Text - Regulatory Context

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 為何眼內用每毫升計而非每容器計？
blocks.en: Core Concept - Why Is the Intraocular Limit Expressed per Milliliter Rather Than per Container?

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 採用每毫升（/mL）的限度，而不是每容器計，原因很直觀：眼內注射劑的體積極小（0.05–0.1 mL），如果用每容器計，限度數字會極小而難以管理。
blocks.en: <789> uses limits per milliliter (/mL) rather than per container for an intuitive reason: intraocular injections have extremely small volumes (0.05–0.1 mL), so per-container limits would be tiny numbers that are hard to manage.

blocks.zh: 舉例：若設定每容器 10 粒，對 0.05 mL 的產品換算成每毫升就是 200/mL — 這個數字太大，不能反映眼部安全需求。
blocks.en: For example, if the limit were set at 10 particles per container, a 0.05 mL product would convert to 200/mL - a number far too large to reflect ocular safety needs.

blocks.zh: 用 /mL 作為通用基礎，讓限度與體積無關，更適合眼科多樣化的產品規格（如從 0.05 mL 的抗 VEGF 到 10 mL 的眼科沖洗液）。
blocks.en: Using /mL as a common basis makes the limits independent of volume, which suits the diverse product presentations in ophthalmology (from 0.05 mL anti-VEGF products to 10 mL ophthalmic irrigating solutions).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 〈789〉 的程序性規定依賴 〈788〉
blocks.en: Key Point - The Procedural Provisions of <789> Rely on <788>

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 是一個「輕量型」章節 — 它本身不包含完整的試驗程序，而是直接引用：
blocks.en: <789> is a "lightweight" chapter - it does not contain complete test procedures itself, but instead refers directly to:

blocks.zh: LO 法 → 「按 〈788〉 Method 1 執行」
blocks.en: LO method → "perform as described in <788> Method 1"

blocks.zh: 顯微鏡法 → 「按 〈788〉 Method 2 執行」
blocks.en: Microscopic method → "perform as described in <788> Method 2"

blocks.zh: 實務意義：眼科 QC 實驗室需要同時熟悉 〈788〉 的完整程序和 〈789〉 的特定限度。在 SOP 撰寫時，程序部分引用 〈788〉，判定標準引用 〈789〉。
blocks.en: Practical implication: ophthalmic QC laboratories need to be familiar with both the complete procedures of <788> and the specific limits of <789>. When writing SOPs, the procedure section references <788> and the acceptance criteria reference <789>.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的影響：同一個儀器和方法可以用於一般注射劑（〈788〉）和眼內注射劑（〈789〉），降低了設備投資和方法開發成本。
blocks.en: Impact on CDMOs: the same instrument and method can be used for ordinary injections (<788>) and intraocular injections (<789>), reducing equipment investment and method development costs.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 法規申報的章節引用策略
blocks.en: Practical Application - Chapter Citation Strategy in Regulatory Filings

blocks.zh: 在向 FDA 申報眼內注射製劑（NDA/BLA）時，微粒測試規格的引用方式：
blocks.en: When filing an intraocular injection with the FDA (NDA/BLA), the particulate test specification is referenced as follows:

blocks.zh: 在 CTD 3.2.P.5（製劑的控制）中，微粒測試應引用 USP 〈789〉 作為方法依據
blocks.en: In CTD 3.2.P.5 (Control of Drug Product), the particulate test should cite USP <789> as the basis for the method

blocks.zh: 如果採用 LO 法，程序應符合 〈788〉 Method 1；如果採用顯微鏡法，符合 〈788〉 Method 2
blocks.en: If the LO method is used, the procedure should comply with <788> Method 1; if the microscopic method is used, with <788> Method 2

blocks.zh: 接受標準必須滿足 〈789〉 表 1 或表 2 的三個粒徑限度（50/5/2 per mL）
blocks.en: The acceptance criteria must meet the three size limits in <789> Table 1 or Table 2 (50/5/2 per mL)

blocks.zh: 如果個別品種有 USP 專論，以專論規格優先；若無專論，〈789〉 通則為準
blocks.en: If an individual USP monograph exists, the monograph specification takes precedence; if there is no monograph, the <789> general chapter applies

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 適用於眼內（玻璃體腔）注射液，是 〈788〉 在眼科領域的專用版本，2024 年正式更名為「Intraocular Solutions」
blocks.en: <789> applies to intraocular (intravitreal) injections and is the ophthalmic-specific version of <788>; it was formally renamed "Intraocular Solutions" in 2024

blocks.zh: 微粒定義：移動性、隨機來源、非預期的不溶性物質，以 /mL 作為限度基礎
blocks.en: Definition of particles: mobile, randomly sourced, unintended insoluble matter, with /mL as the basis for limits

blocks.zh: 三個粒徑限度（LO 法與顯微鏡法相同）：≥10 µm（50/mL）、≥25 µm（5/mL）、≥50 µm（2/mL）— 比 〈788〉 嚴格約 24 倍，並增加了 ≥50 µm 限度
blocks.en: Three size limits (the same for the LO and microscopic methods): ≥10 µm (50/mL), ≥25 µm (5/mL), ≥50 µm (2/mL) - about 24 times stricter than <788>, with an added ≥50 µm limit

blocks.zh: LO 法為首選（尤其含矽油時），但對高黏度、有顏色或體積受限的產品，顯微鏡法是適當替代，且兩種方法使用相同的限度標準
blocks.en: The LO method is the first choice (especially when silicone oil is present), but for products that are highly viscous, colored or volume-limited, the microscopic method is a suitable alternative, and both methods use the same limit criteria

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 程序上引用 〈788〉 的 Method 1/Method 2，自身只提供適用範圍和接受標準
blocks.en: <789> refers to Method 1/Method 2 of <788> for procedures and itself provides only the scope and acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 個別品種專論的規定優先於 〈789〉 通則；稀釋操作需依 〈1788〉 執行並有適當文件
blocks.en: The requirements of an individual monograph take precedence over the <789> general chapter; dilution must be performed per <1788> and properly documented
